units.source_text: “我虽然很同情夫人，但还是起身打开了刚刚关上的隔扇门。

en.t: Although I felt very sorry for the lady, I still got up and opened the sliding door I had just closed.

units.source_text: 此时K房间的灯油似乎已经燃尽，室内一团漆黑。

en.t: By then the oil in K's lamp seemed to have burned out, and the room was completely dark.

units.source_text: 我回屋拿来自己的油灯，站在门口回头示意夫人。

en.t: I went back to my room, brought my own lamp, stood in the doorway, and looked back to signal to the lady.

units.source_text: 夫人躲在我身后，朝四叠的屋里窥探，但不想进去。

en.t: The lady hid behind me and peered into the four-mat room, but she did not want to go in.

units.source_text: 她嘱咐我，屋里要保持原样，打开木板套窗。

en.t: She told me to leave the room just as it was and open the wooden storm shutters.

units.source_text: 真不愧是军人的妻子，接下来的事情夫人处理得有条不紊。

en.t: As one would expect of a soldier's wife, the lady handled everything that followed in an orderly way.

units.source_text: 我去请了医生，跑了警察署，也都是按照夫人的吩咐做的。

en.t: I went to fetch a doctor and hurried to the police station, all according to the lady's instructions.

units.source_text: 在这些程序做完之前，夫人不准任何人进入K的房间。

en.t: Until these procedures were finished, the lady would not allow anyone to enter K's room.

units.source_text: K是用小刀割断颈动脉，迅疾毙命的，除此之外没有发现其他创伤。

en.t: K had cut his carotid artery with a small knife and died almost at once; no other wounds were found.

units.source_text: 这时我才知道，刚才在恍如梦境般昏暗的灯光下所看到的隔扇上的血迹，是从他的脖颈里喷射出来的。

en.t: Only then did I realize that the bloodstains I had seen on the sliding door in that dim, dreamlike lamplight had sprayed from his neck.

units.source_text: 在白天的光线下，我再次清楚地看到了那些血迹，我惊骇于人的血流竟会这般迅猛。

en.t: In the daylight I saw those bloodstains clearly once more, and I was horrified that human blood could flow with such force.

units.source_text: 夫人和我想尽办法，干脆利落地把K的房间打扫干净。

en.t: The lady and I used every means we could think of and quickly cleaned K's room.

units.source_text: 幸好他流出的血大都被他的被褥吸收了，所以叠上没有多少血，清理起来没有费太大劲。

en.t: Fortunately, most of the blood he had shed was absorbed by his bedding, so there was not much blood on the tatami, and cleaning up was not too difficult.

units.source_text: 我们俩把他的尸体抬到我的房间，让他像平时睡觉那样躺在那里，然后我出去给他的家人打电报去了。

en.t: The two of us carried his body to my room and laid him there as though he were sleeping as usual; then I went out to send a telegram to his family.
